name: Witch's Broom
note: Halloween 2026 (lane Cues B, docs/prompts/HW_CUES_B_PROMPT.md 2.4, concept C3b_broom.png), remade 2026-10-28 (Justin 12:55): a real broom, a gnarled twisted branch with knots and a broken stub, a violet crystal tip with a silver coil, a thick purple binding with a silver buckle and gold crescent, a big full head of golden straw (3.3x), a swaying witch-hat charm; moons, stars, bats and spell stars round it, potion smoke and bats out of the bristles, sparks from the crystal. No ribbons. v3 (2026-10-29): the finisher is a witch's-hat constellation and the witch alone, no portal rings or moon.

vfx.Piece: pieces/witch_broom_aura: the concept's glowing ribbons as a 3D decor piece round the whole handle, the Firework's way: two narrow saturated Neon strips (violet #8B30FF, emerald #19E088, 0.09 wide, 0.2 off the bark, a turn every 1.8 studs) turning like screws in opposite senses with a Glow breath toward a lighter tint of their own hue; a thin gold sparkle thread the other way, twinkling; three gold crescent moons, five four-point stars and two flapping bats orbiting the handle. Second build (designer, 2026-10-28 11:55); the wide pale bands and the Glow toward white of the first retune bloomed into a white sheet in daylight and are gone.

Moving.Note: The moons, stars, bats and spell stars (the aura piece), the two orbiters and the halo beam move; the crystal glows 0.25-1.0 over 2.4 s; the charm swings over 1.8 s; the bristle head flexes over 2.6 and 4 s.

Aura.Note: Secret (brief 2.4), third build (Justin 12:55: no ribbons, the Broom's own effects), inside out: a deep violet haze body, a violet additive glow, emerald wisps, violet motes, star and gold glints, crescent flecks along the handle; at the bristle head potion smoke curling up out of the straw (teal to violet), potion bubbles rising, straw leaves flying off and bats bursting out of it; sparks and a flare spraying from the crystal; a sparkle trickle from the hat charm; spell pops (four star pops, sparks; no rings); one violet halo beam; a violet PointLight at the crystal, an emerald one mid-handle and a gold one at the binding; two sparkle heads riding the cue; violet outline. About 169 particles a second before BackRateScale (budget 170).

Trail.Note: Stars, crescents, straw leaves and a few bats riding the ball behind a violet-emerald ribbon with a white-violet core.

Pocket.Note: Secret, about 2.2 s, v3 (designer 2026-10-29: the portal rings read like the Beta cue's; no moon, the witch smoother and faster): a violet flash; a witch's-hat constellation (pieces/witch_broom_stars: eight Neon stars joined by violet chart lines, twinkling at their own pace, dust stars round it) rises and grows out of the pocket facing the camera; a dark column behind a fountain of gold five-point stars; twinkling star dust round the hat; then the witch alone (no moon: a 64-frame OneShot flipbook of 128 px cells, 1.05 s, about 60 frames a second, 5 studs, 3.4 up; was 16 frames over 2.2 s) sweeps across the hat's tip with a gold and violet sparkle trail off her bristles; a gold star burst at the hat's tip; bats; stars raining down to close. No ring decals, no swirl disc, no shared gust ribbons (KeepRibbons false); only the shared gust's own shockwave ring on the cloth stays, as on every cue.

Sound.Note: Roblox library: Pro Sound Effects "Magic Whooshes Growly Magic Whooshes Airy Gusts 7" (1.6 s), free, no upload; PreloadAsync Success 2026-10-28

Budget.Note: Third build (2026-10-28, 13:15): the remade broom body (6 parts, 9,600 triangles: gnarled handle, 3.3x straw head) and the aura piece without ribbons (19 parts, 2,392 triangles: moons, stars, bats, three spell stars). v3 (2026-10-29): the finisher piece is the hat constellation witch_broom_stars (11 parts, 652 triangles, was the portal rings' 13 parts, 4,928) and bursts 127 particles once (was 134).
Budget.LivePps: measured 168.4/s in hand and on the back with the two orbiter heads (Config.CueSkins HeadRate 24 each); 180.4 before the trim (robustness pass 2026-10-28)
